programme.title: C Kkompany
programme.desc: A comedy film about three friends who start a fictitious company called C Kkompany to extort money from the corrupt people in their neighborhood. The movie showcases the hilarious consequences of their actions and how they try to redeem themselves in front of the public.

programme.title: Ragini Mms 2
programme.desc: A director attempts to shoot an erotic horror movie in a house where, unbeknown to him, a demonic spirit resides. Even before the crew starts filming, the spirit possesses the lead actress's body.

programme.title: Hum To Mohabbat Karega
